offline_engines.label: Apple系统翻译

minimum_api_availability.availability_source: Apple official symbol Markdown metadata checked 2026-10-30; locked SDK compilation and actual OS checks remain required

offline_engines.non_llm_policy: Use explicit lowLatency where available; older OS/SDK traditional path requires version-specific PoC evidence; highFidelity/Apple Intelligence excluded; unknown route not executable as non-LLM
offline_engines.resource_policy: System-managed language pair: installed/supported/unsupported are distinct; supported does not mean installed; system permission before language downloads; no export/copy of system packages
offline_engines.cancellation_policy: cancel() availability-check; attempts all work in session and cancelled session is not reused; older task cancellation and local discard need PoC; no guaranteed physical stop
offline_engines.cache_identity_policy: OS build + strategy/API + pair + observable resource state + observation epoch; unavailable package version remains unknown; do not reuse across unverifiable epochs

offline_engines.label: Argos专用机器翻译
offline_engines.pipeline_policy: Argos upstream includes package metadata, sentence splitting, tokenization, inference, merging and optional pivoting; CTranslate2 alone is not the full pipeline
offline_engines.resource_policy: Language model packages and tokenizer/sentence-boundary assets required; record package/source/license/engine compatibility/architecture/hash; no automatic download
offline_engines.routing_policy: direct_only default; explicitly selected and applied pivot path freezes each hop; never invoke upstream automatic pivot silently

offline_engines.label: J北京
offline_engines.resource_policy: User-selected legal installation; freeze supported engine/data files, actual PE bitness, ABI and encoding; no DLL or commercial data bundled
offline_engines.upstream_source_evidence: LunaTranslator integration reference only; not vendor compatibility or redistribution proof

offline_runtime_contract_candidates.authority: Rust app-core owns config/permissions/epochs/task scheduling/results; narrow Tauri adapter only

service_selection_design.user_decision: 统一浅层选择翻译服务；配置在别处管理，没有配置好不能选

daily_selection.llm_filter: templatePurpose === translation and explicit translation capability; grammar-only excluded without name inference
daily_selection.http_untested: valid saved supported HTTP configuration may be explicitly selected as unverified; untested is not unconfigured
daily_selection.local_unknown: unknown required system/resource/language/runtime_route health blocks selection; offline gate unchanged
daily_selection.known_failure: current resource/configuration revision known failure blocks selection with reason and recovery

projection_contract_candidate.authority: Rust app-core derives configuration eligibility and saved service projection; UI consumes DTO/application-port through narrow Tauri only

binding_contract_candidate.resource_reference: saved immutable model_config or offline_engine_config revision plus frozen dependencies
binding_contract_candidate.selection_effect: create and activate new purpose binding; subsequent sentences only
binding_contract_candidate.current_sentence_retranslation: independent explicit command; previous result retained
binding_contract_candidate.enable_disable: separate explicit automatic_translation control, validate current binding before enabling
binding_contract_candidate.optimistic_concurrency: expected binding revision and profile generation; revalidate before activate, keep old binding on rejection
binding_contract_candidate.main_and_comparison: one main, ordered comparisons, deduplicate stable resource identity; moving to main removes duplicate comparison
binding_contract_candidate.cancellation: cancel superseded queue/in-flight tasks; reject stale profile/binding/task/attempt/unit/resource callbacks before current result/cache/history commit
binding_contract_candidate.history: preserve existing original sentence/service/version results; cancelled late results cannot write success
binding_contract_candidate.return_behavior: refresh saved list and return to original picker; no automatic selection, test, send or retranslation

scope_boundaries.database: no new DDL; existing candidate field schemes remain unapproved and unchanged
